properties.title: Tarball hindcast trajectory, Santa Barbara, CA
properties.content: Mid-afternoon on 25-JUNE-2012, CA Office of Spill Prevention & Response (OSPR) called their NOAA SSC to request hindcast trajectory support for an area of tarballs observed this morning along approximately one mile of shoreline just East of Santa Barbara, CA.  The tarballs were described as similar in character to oil released from Platform Houchin early last Friday morning (0330 hours local time on 22-JUNE-2012).  OSPR and USCG Marine Safety Detachment Santa Barbara inquired whether the Platform Houchin might be the source of the tarballs.

properties.title: Mystery slick, North end of Barataria Bay, La.
properties.content: At 1030 CDT, Sept 15, 2011 there was a report of a 1 mile by 1/2 mile slick at the north end of Barataria Bay.  The CG asked if we could help locate the source.
